data.narrative:
Strata Robotics is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Zhou and Alex Mason that has raised $5.2M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

A stage-progression method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Using the $5.2M in total capital raised as a base proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $13M. A peer-median approach cannot be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow robotics subset; while 8 same-sector peers exist broadly, fewer than 3 meet the tighter filters needed for statistically meaningful cross-sectional comparison.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $15M, with a median estimate of $13M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around (1) the appropriate stage-progression multiplier given Strata's specific technology maturity and market traction relative to typical Seed-to-A dynamics, and (2) the absence of tightly comparable peers at similar stage and capitalization. Validation through additional operational or market data would strengthen conviction in this range.
